fullContentHtml:
UPSSSC Pharmacist Final Answer Key 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has releases the final answer key for the post of Pharmacist on the official website of the UPSSSC. Online applying process for UPSSSC Pharmacist Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 09 March 2026 & the candidates can apply till the 31 March 2026. The Examination was held on 29 June 2026. Candidates who had appeared in this examination can download their UPSSSC Pharmacist Final Answer Key 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 09 March 2026
  • Last Date : 31 March 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 31 March 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 07 April 2026
  • Eligibility Result : 18 May 2026
  • Exam Date : 29 June 2026
  • Exam City Details : 22 June 2026
  • Admit Card Available : 25 June 2026
  • Answer Key : 01 July 2026
  • Final Answer Key : 20 August 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, ST, Candidates : Rs. 25/-
  • PH Candidates : Rs. 25/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Download Answer Key

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the answer key link.
  3. Select your exam date / shift / paper code.
  4. Download the answer key PDF.
  5. Calculate your expected marks and raise objections if any by the specified deadline.
